# The Tiny Italian

> > The Tiny Italian offers curated cooking playlists and kitchen entertainment to inspire joyful home cooking experiences.

The Tiny Italian creates music-driven cooking experiences, with their signature 'Cook Love Dance' playlist designed to motivate and entertain home cooks in the kitchen.
